text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Well, hello there, Trainer. I'm sorry you
had to
see that.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Recently, my creative juices have been
flowing
best after the sun exits its
heavenly stage.
choice_data_list_en: You look pretty sleepy, don't you.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: My latest work is an opera written by and starring yours truly. Overlord of the Rose Sky will be told in twenty-six parts.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Upon completion, this masterpiece will
surely be
seen as a revolutionary
contribution changing the
realm of fine
arts!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
T.M. Opera O seems fulfilled with her
recent
productivity, but it's also
apparent she could use
more rest.
